PE and Sports Premium
Since 2013, the Government has provided schools with funding to be able to make long-term improvements to the quality of PE, sport and physical activities they provide for their pupils. Schools are able to decide how they spend this money but attention must be paid in particular to ensuring that it is used to be able to provide a diverse range of opportunities for pupils and staff as well as making sure that the changes are sustainable.
The main key indicators schools are encouraged to be aware of are:
Increased participation in competitive sport.
PE and Sports Premium funding
Our updated PE and Sport Premium report for 2025–26 will be published once the final allocation and spending summary are confirmed.
